repositories.name: bicep
repositories.description: Bicep is a declarative language for describing and deploying Azure resources

paragraphs: Bicep is an infrastructure-as-code (IaC) programming language that uses declarative syntax to deploy Azure resources. In a Bicep file, you define the infrastructure you want to deploy to Azure and then use that file throughout the development lifecycle to repeatedly deploy that infrastructure. Your resources are deployed in a consistent manner.
Learn more about the language and benefits of using Bicep in the What is Bicep documentation.
